header: The pads' plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, played with its tools/gamepad_probe.js as the preload
(--preload) and tools/pads.js's helpers: four stand-in pads plugged in at the launcher, before Start Game, as a
player's pads are there when the game starts. Their ids are Chrome's on Windows for an Xbox pad over XInput (two),
a DualSense and a Bluetooth Xbox pad, whose ids are longer than SDL keeps and which SDL renames, so the page has to
find each by its place in navigator.getGamepads(). Each pad plays a port of its own in the order they were plugged
in (RECOMPINPUT_PADS_IN_ORDER), so the game counts four controllers (gControllersConnected, 0x800DD228) and its VS
Battle offers four players. The pads alone drive the menus: the first pad's Start to the main menu, its d-pad to VS
Battle (gSelectedMode, 0x800CD380) and to 4P (VS's gModeSubOption, 0x800CD394), then every pad's A through machine
select, the machines' settings and course select into a race of four (gGameMode 5, VS_4P), split four ways. There
the computer drives all four machines (tools/pads.js's cpuDrive), which meet the walls and each other, and after a
minute of the game's time the rumble must have reached at least three of the four pads (padRumbles(): plays per
pad, in the order they were plugged in).
